REF: PPR/2022 - 02/1
PUBLIC NOTICE ON CAP PRICES FOR PETROLEUM PRODUCTS EFFECTIVE
WEDNESDAY, 2ND FEBRUARY 2022
The Energy and Water Utilities Regulatory Authority (EWURA) hereby publishes
Cap Prices for petroleum products, applicable in Tanzania Mainland. These retail
and wholesale prices are applicable effective from Wednesday, 2nd February
2022. Hereinafter, kindly take note of the following:
(a) Retail and wholesale prices of petrol, diesel and kerosene imported
through Dar es Salaam port have changed compared to prices published
on 5th January 2022. For February 2022, the retail prices of petrol and
kerosene have decreased by TZS 21/litre (equivalent to 0.83%) and TZS
44/litre (equivalent to 1.90%), respectively while the retail price of diesel
has increased by TZS 13/litre (equivalent to 0.57%). Likewise, compared to
the publication of last month, wholesale prices of petrol and kerosene have
decreased by TZS 21.00/litre (equivalent to 0.89%) and TZS 43.80/litre
(equivalent to 1.99%), respectively while the wholesale price of diesel has
increased by TZS 13.20/litre (equivalent to 0.60%).
(b) For February 2022, retail and wholesale prices of petrol and diesel in
the Northern regions (Tanga, Kilimanjaro, Arusha, and Manyara) have
decreased compared to prices published on 5th January 2022. For
February 2022, retail prices of petrol and diesel have decreased by TZS
123/litre (equivalent to 4.89%) and TZS 92/litre (equivalent to 3.90%)
respectively. Similarly, compared to the publication of last month,
wholesale prices of petrol and diesel have decreased by TZS
122.41/litre (equivalent to 5.12%) and TZS 92.53/litre (equivalent to
4.13%), respectively. Due to depletion of kerosene at Tanga storage
terminal, Petrol Station Operators in the Northern regions are advised to
source kerosene from Dar es Salaam. Therefore, the retail prices of
kerosene for those regions are based on the cost of the product received
